about_the_game:
Demo Content:
The trial version includes the Prologue, Chapter 1, and most of Chapter 2 (significant portions).

Players can experience key gameplay mechanics:

  • Class changing for the protagonist

  • Loot grinding for equipment

  • Stat progression system

This demo showcases core game features through substantial playable content.

Basic Controls:
Mouse:

  • Left-click to move

  • Left-click = Confirm

  • Right-click = Cancel

Keyboard:

  • WASD or Arrow Keys (↑←↓→) to move

  • Space or Enter = Confirm

  • Esc key = Cancel

Mouse and keyboard controls can be used interchangeably.

Background Story:
In the year 3011, humanity faces growing peril as monsters invade year after year. Fortunately, a group of Demon Hunters protects their kin.

Mo Jiu, the protagonist, is one of them. Though ranked at the lowest D-tier, he possesses a unique trait no one else has. One day, he encounters a "Junk System" robot that promises endless growth—but forces him to scavenge for scrap. Wait... Why is there top-tier gear hidden in this junk pile?! Thus begins his legendary journey: growing stronger, recruiting allies, and battling monsters.

Gameplay:

  • Classic Japanese-style RPG (JRPG) with turn-based combat

  • Command up to 4 characters in your party

  • Dozens of equipment types, expansive maps, and 10,000+ words of story

  • Protagonist can advance twice; some companions advance once

  • Strategize your team: 3-support/1-damage or full offensive synergy? Craft your imaginative party composition!

  • Grind levels, farm rare gear, and boost stats (continuously growing stats may eclipse equipment!)

  • Conquer the main story, then challenge the post-game Supreme Tower!

Final Notes:
Join our QQ group: 973908965 to share feedback, suggestions, or discuss the game with others!

I develop the game entirely on my own, and this is my debut project. As a gamer with over a decade of experience (Bilibili: 从零通关), I playtest every feature during development, refining anything that feels unsatisfying. I hope you enjoy the adventure—your support means everything! Feedback is always welcome.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1/10/11 (64位)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 显存≥1GB ，OpenGL 4.1兼容
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any PC with sound
  • Additional Notes: 需64位操作系统
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1/10/11 (64位)
  • Processor: Intel i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any PC with sound
  • Additional Notes: 需64位操作系统；推荐使用固态硬盘提升加载速度

short_description: A turn-based RPG with simple controls. Starting from "scavenging junk" with the help of a "Junk System" robot, you'll grow step by step to eventually battle formidable monsters. Experience a rich storyline, extensive equipment collections, and diverse map designs.
